edits.replacement:
Normative input-validation key for the table above (applies to every occurrence of each named argument; P/R/O are single UTF-8 argv tokens unless the row says rest, flags are booleans with no value). The parser rejects missing required option values, unknown options and extra positionals; a bare option value is not silently synthesized. Optional positionals may be absent; rest paths have cardinality 1..N. Empty strings are rejected where the named owner requires non-empty input; otherwise preserve the owner's current behavior. No global 100-character ID rule or new blanket size limit is introduced. The domain/format below is enforced by the named existing command or value class, after parseEntryInput syntax; state-dependent conditions stay with that owner.

| Input and applicable leaf rows | Type, format, domain/range and owner |
| --- | --- |
| get check target | Required string enum dirty, gh, impl, finalize; VALID_CHECK_TARGETS and GetCheckCommand reject absent/other values. |
| get prompt kind | Required string key in the configured-language prompt registry, including the existing plan.* and impl.* entries; GetPromptCommand owns unknown-key handling. |
| get guardrail phase; run gate/review/recover-review-pass --phase; set metric phase; set retry phase | Required non-empty phase token for the positional forms, optional single token for options; each named guardrail/gate/review/metric/retry command owns its applicable phase registry and state combination. |
| get issue number; set issue number; prepare/set init --issue; target --expect-issue | Required decimal issue number for positionals, single decimal value for options; issue commands and FlowTargetExpectation own positivity/identity checks and conflict with --expect-no-issue. |
| get artifact logicalKey; --mode/--spec-id/--version | Required non-empty artifact key; optional single mode, FlowSpecId, and version token. GetArtifactCommand owns mode/version domains and catalog resolution; FlowSpecId owns spec ID format, with no generic length cap. |
| get status runId; set request/note/auto --run-id; prepare --run-id; get runtime-log --run-id | get status is optional one token; prepare uses PreparingFlowId (non-empty, no colon, at most 200 characters); runtime-log accepts its existing run ID/sequence form; other commands use their own active-flow ID and state checks. |
| set step id,status | Both required non-empty tokens. id resolves through the active definition/step tree; status belongs to VALID_STEP_STATUSES and NormalStepTransition, which reject unknown or forbidden lifecycle transitions. |
| set auto value; set broad action; set policy value; set retry action,kind; set acceptance-decision/nonblocking-decision --choice | Required non-empty positional tokens or one option token as shown; each command's existing domain/decision registry and active state own allowable values and combinations. No new option spelling is created for positional values. |
| set request text; set note text; set draft-answer questionId and --answer/--why/--considered/--dropped-reason | Required non-empty positional text/ID where declared, optional single text values; each command and its question ledger own format, existing size limits and --drop/answer combinations. |
| set files reqId, paths | Required non-empty requirement ID plus at least one rest token; CanonicalFileMapUpdate checks the requirement and normalizes each non-empty repository-relative path, while FlowManager.updateFileMap checks active attempt/state. It maps paths; it does not read the referenced file contents. |
| get context path/--search/--raw; set review-evidence --file; run gate --spec; run --agent-work-dir | Context path optional existing file in file mode (absolute or project-root-relative); search single query; review evidence existing non-symlink regular JSON file under its existing byte limit; gate spec exact existing Spec file path for task-spec phase; agent work directory non-empty NUL-free absolute or repository-root-relative directory path and need not pre-exist. Existing get-context, ReviewEvidenceInput, gate command and src/sennel.js/resolver own these respectively. |
| resume --spec; prepare --base; run lint --base | FlowSpecId for resume; Git branch name for each base; respective resume, prepare and lint owners validate their different formats. |
| --format, --mode, --sequence, --category, --record-category, --step, --task-id, --normalized-finding-id, --repair-ref-commit, --repair-ref-file, --expect-attempt-id, --approve, --exclusions | Each is one value token, optional unless its leaf state requires it. The named get/run/set owner validates its existing enum, positive integer sequence, canonical ID, commit reference, path reference, approval choice or serialized exclusions JSON and existing size/entry bounds. No spelling-wide validator substitutes for the owner. |
| --expect-binding, --expect-spec, --expect-run-id, --expect-issue, --expect-no-issue | Only on rows whose G column admits them. FlowTargetExpectation validates the non-empty token (maximum 300 characters) or issue number and buildFlowCommandHookContext checks the selected target before handler mutation; --expect-issue and --expect-no-issue conflict. |
| all other row-local F/O names | A flag has cardinality 0..1 and boolean value; each option has cardinality 0..1 and one required token unless the registry declares optionalOptions. The row's leaf command owns non-empty, path, domain and state checks; no shared semantic admission rule is added. |

finding.body:
**Target:** R1 normative leaf map; Acceptance Criteria baseline counts
**Issue:** Current FLOW_COMMANDS contains 66 non-query leaves: resume 1, prepare 1, get 11, set 17, run 35, and report/show 1. The normative map omits run final-regression and run report, while the spec also claims both 65 and 66 rows.
**Required change:** Reconcile the baseline to the current registry, include run final-regression and run report with their contracts, and use one consistent count everywhere.
**Why blocking:** A registry-derived implementation or contract test will either omit live commands or assert conflicting membership/counts, leaving parser, help, lifecycle, and success-fixture coverage incomplete.
finding.evidence: R1 and three acceptance criteria state 65 non-query leaves and run 34, while the same Spec also requires 66 success rows and T-9 explicitly calls for a 66-row matrix including run report. The canonical review identifies the live registry count as 66 and run 35. Reconcile the inventory and all count assertions from the registry.

finding.body:
**Target:** R7 target matrix; R1/R2 artifact and status guard applicability
**Issue:** get status and get artifact have targetGuard:false at the dispatcher registry boundary but perform command-owned guard checks. get artifact additionally bypasses ambient Flow resolution for explicit spec-id/version and rejects active guards on historical views.
**Required change:** Add an explicit ownership/mode matrix for these entries, preserving dispatcher selection, command-level validation, and the historical artifact bypass/rejection behavior.
**Why blocking:** Treating buildFlowCommandHookContext as the sole guard owner can remove positional-status validation or break historical artifact reads by resolving or applying active guards in the wrong phase.
finding.evidence: R7 assigns target checks to FlowTargetExpectation/buildFlowCommandHookContext generally, while R1 lists get status and get artifact among guarded inputs. The canonical review identifies targetGuard:false on both entries and command-owned checks, plus artifact historical-view bypass and active-guard rejection. The ownership/mode exception needs to be explicit.

finding.body:
**Target:** R8 set review-evidence path row
**Issue:** SetReviewEvidenceCommand passes executionRoot as specDir to ReviewEvidenceInput.fromFile. The existing owner therefore bounds evidence input to the execution checkout, while the spec requires it to be inside the active canonical spec directory.
**Required change:** Change the requirement to the existing execution-root path contract and name ReviewEvidenceInput.fromFile as the owner, unless an intentional compatibility-changing relocation is in scope.
**Why blocking:** In worktree execution, valid worker-produced evidence under the execution checkout would be rejected, so implementation and integration tests would disagree about accepted inputs.

finding.body:
**Target:** R8 get context path row; R2 path inventory
**Issue:** get-context.js resolves the supplied path with path.resolve(root, filePath) and does not reject absolute paths or enforce a project-relative boundary. The spec describes the path as project-root-relative without recording the current absolute-path acceptance.
**Required change:** Record that both absolute and root-relative paths are currently accepted, with get-context.js owning resolution and file errors, or explicitly scope a path-boundary behavior change.
**Why blocking:** Tests cannot determine whether an absolute existing path should succeed or fail; enforcing the stated relative-only wording would change existing command behavior.

finding.body:
**Target:** R2/R8 run gate --spec contract
**Issue:** RunGateCommand consumes ctx.spec only in the task-spec branch. For canonical draft/spec phases it reads the Flow-owned Spec record and ignores --spec; in task-spec it reads the exact resolved path and does not normalize a directory to spec.json.
**Required change:** State the task-spec-only combination and current exact-file behavior, or explicitly define directory normalization and phase behavior as an intentional scope change.
**Why blocking:** A test using a directory, or --spec during another gate phase, has no deterministic expected result and a generic path validator could alter target selection and gate behavior.
finding.evidence: R8 says run gate --spec accepts a Spec directory or spec.json path. The canonical review identifies task-spec-only consumption of ctx.spec as an exact file path and canonical draft/spec phases using the Flow-owned Spec record. Record that phase-dependent behavior instead of introducing directory normalization.

finding.body:
**Target:** R9/T7 lifecycle acceptance
**Issue:** dispatcher.js has distinct paths for thrown command errors, returned Envelope failures, post-hook failures, and entry.nonblockingPost. nonblockingPost is used by gate, review, retro, final-regression, and acceptance-review to record durable evidence, and its invocation is conditional on outbox state.
**Required change:** Extend the lifecycle contract and tests to cover nonblockingPost ordering/skip conditions, Envelope-failure versus thrown-error handling, and existing failure ownership alongside pre/post/onError.
**Why blocking:** A parser or registry refactor could preserve exit codes while dropping durable review evidence or changing hook invocation and Flow-state mutation, which the current acceptance criteria would not detect.

finding.body:
**Target:** T2/T9 dispatcher integration boundary
**Issue:** parseEntryInput is shared by flow, docs, check, metrics, and spec commands; non-flow entries also rely on passthroughArgs, optionalOptions, and _rawArgs. The scope and tests define only flow coverage while proposing changes to the shared dispatcher.
**Required change:** Specify that the typed projection is flow-entry-only and require preservation tests for non-flow CommandDefinition entries, passthrough parsing, optional options, and raw argv forwarding.
**Why blocking:** A global parser change can break existing non-flow commands without any flow matrix failure, violating the existing CLI compatibility contract.

**Required change:** Add a concrete registry-derived 66-row inventory, excluding query, with the required arity, domain, conditional, path, owner, description, and test-boundary fields for every current leaf.

finding.body:
**Target:** R2/R8 set files limits
**Issue:** CanonicalFileMapUpdate and FlowManager.updateFileMap enforce normalized non-empty repository-relative paths and active-attempt/requirement checks, but no explicit set-files count or aggregate-size limit is present. The query and snapshot limits are separate read-side contracts.
**Required change:** Record set-files count and aggregate input limits as explicitly unbounded under the existing file-map/publication owners, or identify a verified existing limit and owner.
**Why blocking:** Adding the claimed limits would introduce an arbitrary compatibility restriction; omitting them leaves over-limit behavior and its tests undefined.
finding.evidence: R2 asks for set-files count and aggregate limits and R8 delegates count/aggregate rules to FlowManager.updateFileMap. The canonical review identifies no explicit bound in CanonicalFileMapUpdate or FlowManager.updateFileMap; record explicit absence and those existing owners without importing query/read-side limits.
